definition.name: Low-voltage LED light
definition.description: The driver feeds this light. Look for the positive and negative marks on the low-voltage side.

terminals.purpose: Positive LED input on this low-voltage light. It takes power from the DC driver.
Negative LED return on this low-voltage light. It takes power from the DC driver.

parts.name: Housing
parts.purpose: The case holds the working parts in place and keeps them apart.

parts.name: Removable cover
parts.purpose: Lift the cover on the bench to see the connections underneath.

parts.name: Terminal clamps
parts.purpose: A clamp holds the bare end of a wire against the metal terminal.

parts.name: Mounting and fixings
parts.purpose: These keep the fitting in place. Look for the screws or clips that hold it.

parts.name: Light source
parts.purpose: This is the part that gives off light. On the bench it gets brighter as it receives more power.

parts.name: Control board
parts.purpose: The board takes signals in and controls the outputs. The bench shows what the board does at its terminals.

terminals.label: +24 V
terminals.purpose: The positive wire meets the copper pad marked +24 V here.
The negative wire returns to the driver from this pad marked −.

data.detailPurpose: The cut mark runs between the two copper pads.
The white packages hold the LEDs. The dark parts are resistors.
Seven LED windows light one cut section of this tape.
